contract: v8 INPUT-TIMING arm: PREREGISTRATION, frozen and committed before any v8 fit, smoke or held-out run. Science card A (motion vision), 10 Oct 2026.
hypothesis: The v7 F1 and the upstream diagnostic show excess latency at the R1-R6 -> LMC stage (model LMCs peak 14-22 ms AFTER R; Drosophila LMCs peak ~13 ms BEFORE R). If R1-R6 phototransduction timing and L1/L2 membrane timing are fitted to Drosophila R/LMC voltage timing, the UNCHANGED v6 leak40 medulla should predict the Behnia 2014 medulla filter timing.
label: EXPLORATORY; post hoc to v7 F1 and the upstream diagnostic. Inherits S1-A3 photoreceptor gain/adaptation (G, Ka, tau_a: FIT REJECTED in S1) and leak40 (hypothetical).

free_parameters.dead_time_note: the phototransduction dead time is an integer ring length; it is profiled over this fixed grid (one set of runs per value), not optimised continuously
free_parameters.fixed: R1-R6: G, Ka, tau_a_ms, n_stages=4, encoder_to_intensity (S1-A3) and the R1-R6 RELEASE (a synapse); L1/L2: e_leak (-40), Ih slope k (5 mV) and reversal (-30 mV); L3 entirely (no subtype data: Mansour's LMCs are unidentified, dominated by L1/L2; disclosed); every medulla type; every edge and base weight (graph 4b2f87cc...091d01)
free_parameters.identifiability: LMC targets (pooled subtype) are applied to BOTH L1 and L2; tau_m and Ih trade off; R gain/adaptation stays at the rejected S1-A3 values

targets.sources: flash_*: Mansour et al. 2026 Supp. Fig. 1b (Drosophila, printed values); impulse/dead time: Juusola & Hardie 2001 text endpoints (V8_data_pin.json)

protocols.cutout: the frozen S2 7-column cutout (scripts/v6/fit_s2.build_cutout); readout = a central-column R1-R6 node, the central L1 and L2
protocols.flash_level_assumption: encoder 330 = 3.3 x BG0 = JH2001's brightest impulse (~10,000 effective photons per ms); Mansour's 'bright' flash intensity is not given in photons; ASSUMPTION
protocols.impulse: 1 ms to 3 x background (contrast +2), record 150 ms; ASSUMPTION about JH2001's impulse contrast
protocols.measurement: deflection from the pre-stimulus value; onset = first |dV| >= 10 % of peak; time to peak = argmax |dV| (scripts/v8/v8_input.measure)
protocols.definition_mismatch: JH2001 dead time = first quantum bumps; Mansour latency = visible response onset; the model uses one 10 %-of-peak onset for both (disclosed)

objective: sum of squared standardised errors over: flash R tp and latency, flash L1 and L2 tp and latency, R impulse tp and onset at BG-4 and BG0 (v8_input.objective; non-finite -> 1e6)

optimiser.start_0: base values clipped to the bounds
optimiser.start_1: Latin hypercube in the transformed box
optimiser.selection: among COMPLETED runs whose own gates give TRAIN_PASS, the lowest objective; tie -> lowest run id (v8_input.outcome)
optimiser.completion: a run killed at the 2 h wall cap or crashed is not completed; fewer than 6 of 12 completed -> NOT EVALUABLE (never F1)
optimiser.resources: CPU only, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty, NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=1, <= 4 processes at a time, nice, taskset -c 0-3

compute_budget.per_eval: ~1.3 s (16.4 s simulated on the 97-cell cutout at the v7-measured ~0.077 s per simulated s; EXTRAPOLATED, step 0 measures it)
compute_budget.fit: 12 runs x 2000 evaluations x ~1.3 s = ~8.7 core-h; 3 waves of 4 = ~2.2 h wall; hard cap 2 h wall per run

training.G1: flash R1-R6 time to peak within 25.5 +- 2 x 2.4 ms
training.G2: flash L1 AND L2 time to peak within 12.2 +- 2 x 1.1 ms AND earlier than R
training.G3: flash onset of R, L1, L2 each within 4-10 ms AND |L - R| <= 3 ms (no synaptic delay)
training.G4: impulse R time to peak within 25 % of 40 ms (BG-4) and 20 ms (BG0) AND faster at BG0
training.G5: impulse R onset within 30 % of 20 ms (BG-4) and 10 ms (BG0)
training.TRAIN_PASS: G1-G5 on the run's own parameters (v8_input.train_gates)

heldout.protocol: frozen params_v8.json, medulla at v6 leak40 (NO medulla fitting), v7 v2 noise protocol and observation model (filter against u = c/2), Behnia digitised filters from the v7 pin
heldout.H1: model filter peak within 2 x text s.e.m. + 5 ms of the digitised peak for >= 3 of Mi1, Tm3, Tm1, Tm2
heldout.H2: Mi1 later than Tm3 AND Tm1 later than Tm2, each by >= 5 ms
heldout.descriptive_only: filter NRMSE and response s.d. vs Fig. 3a (the v7 amplitude gap is not expected to close: see synapse test)
heldout.label: independent data (other lab, cells, method) but NOT analyst-blind

outcomes.NOT_EVALUABLE: fewer than 6 of 12 runs completed: no claim; stop
outcomes.F1_input: no completed run reaches TRAIN_PASS: R1-R6 phototransduction timing plus L1/L2 tau/Ih cannot reproduce Drosophila R/LMC timing (in particular LMC peaking before R with no synaptic delay) with the v6 release synapse fixed: the R->LMC transfer model itself is falsified for timing. Stop.
outcomes.F2_propagation: TRAIN_PASS but HELDOUT_PASS false: correct input timing does NOT make the unchanged medulla reproduce Behnia's timing; the remaining error is in the medulla/synapse model, not the inputs
outcomes.PASS: TRAIN_PASS and HELDOUT_PASS: input timing alone accounts for the medulla timing (exploratory). Any S3 needs a separate owner go and its own addendum (S3 protocol as v7 v2, --params changed).
outcomes.always_reported: all runs, all gates, the synapse test

synapse_transfer_test.status: PREREGISTERED, DESCRIPTIVE (no gate on any arm, no fit); no non-motion paired L1-Mi1/Tm3 voltage measurement was found to fit to
synapse_transfer_test.run_on: params_v6_S2A_leak40.json now-or-later, and the frozen params_v8.json if TRAIN_PASS
synapse_transfer_test.measures: (a) steady-state L1/Mi1/Tm3 voltage at encoder 0-1000 and slope dMi1/dL1; (b) Behnia Fig. 2 protocol flash onset peaks; (c) disinhibition CEILING: L1 release gain set to 0 in memory (= L1 clamped at E_inh) from dark rest
synapse_transfer_test.reading: ceiling(Mi1) < 15 mV (half of Behnia's 30.2 mV Fig. 2 onset) -> the ON amplitude shortfall cannot be closed by L1 gain or input timing in this synapse/conductance model (structural); otherwise it is an operating-point/gain issue

sequence: 0 smoke: one timed objective evaluation at run 0 (no optimisation) to measure cost
1 fit: 12 runs (dead-time grid x 2 starts), <= 4 at a time -> select_v8.py -> if TRAIN_PASS commit params_v8.json (frozen)
2 held-out once on the frozen file (heldout_v8.py)
3 synapse transfer test on v6 leak40 and the frozen file
4 report; STOP (no S3 without a separate go)
risks: flash intensity mapping (encoder 330) and impulse contrast are assumptions
Mansour LMC subtype is pooled; applied to both L1 and L2; L3 left fixed
R gain/adaptation inherit the REJECTED S1-A3 fit
dead-time definitions differ between sources and model
JH2001 values are approximate text endpoints (~40/~20, ~20/~10); no intermediate backgrounds
Mansour n=4/5, single condition, recently published (May 2026)
the 7-column cutout lacks external inputs; the held-out is fitted nowhere but the analyst has seen it
post hoc arm after v7 F1
the R->LMC release is fixed: if LMC-before-R needs a synaptic high-pass (Mansour's feedback/predictive synapse), F1 is the expected outcome and is informative
